what: Regal Rexnord makes the things that make machines move: electric motors, gearboxes, bearings, conveyor components and the couplings between them, for industrial equipment of every kind.
customers: Machinery builders, food and beverage plants, data centres, warehouses and aerospace manufacturers.
money: conveying components, couplings and motion control
motors for HVAC, pools and commercial equipment
moat: Components specified into a machine's design and bought as replacements for its life, in a business where downtime costs far more than the part.
risks: $4.9B of debt from the Altra acquisition, which is the central issue for this company
47 times earnings because amortisation from that deal suppresses the accounting profit
Revenue has drifted down from $6.3B to $5.9B as industrial demand softened
opportunities: $486M of free cash flow against $232M of reported net income, and it is going to debt reduction
Analysts see about 42% upside, with 10 covering the stock
Data centre cooling and warehouse automation are growing end markets for its motion products
watch: Debt reduction per quarter and organic order growth.
